column3: FireRed: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.\n\nLeafGreen: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

FireRed: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.\n\nLeafGreen: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

FireRed: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.\n\nLeafGreen: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

FireRed: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.\n\nLeafGreen: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

FireRed: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.\n\nLeafGreen: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

FireRed: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.\n\nLeafGreen: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

FireRed: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.\n\nLeafGreen: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

FireRed: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.\n\nLeafGreen: It often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For fast swimming, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

FireRed: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.\n\nLeafGreen: The pressurized water jets on this brutal POKéMON’s shell are used for high-speed tackles.

FireRed: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.\n\nLeafGreen: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

FireRed: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.\n\nLeafGreen: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

FireRed: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.\n\nLeafGreen: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

FireRed: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.\n\nLeafGreen: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp stinger on its head that injects poison.

FireRed: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.\n\nLeafGreen: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

FireRed: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.\n\nLeafGreen: It flies at high speed and attacks using the large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

column2: Route 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 12, 13, 14, 15, 24, 25, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Five Isle Meadow
column3: FireRed: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.\n\nLeafGreen: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

column2: Route 13, 14, 15, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Five Isle Meadow
column3: FireRed: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.\n\nLeafGreen: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

FireRed: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.\n\nLeafGreen: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

FireRed: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.\n\nLeafGreen: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

FireRed: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.\n\nLeafGreen: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

column2: Route 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 16, 17, 18, 22, 23, Canyon Entrance, Cape Brink, Kindle Road, Mt. Ember, Ruin Valley, Treasure Beach, Water Path
column3: FireRed: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.\n\nLeafGreen: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

column2: Route 17, 18, 23, Canyon Entrance, Cape Brink, Kindle Road, Mt. Ember, Ruin Valley, Sevault Canyon, Treasure Beach, Water Path
column3: FireRed: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.\n\nLeafGreen: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

FireRed: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.\n\nLeafGreen: Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

FireRed: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.\n\nLeafGreen: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

FireRed: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.\n\nLeafGreen: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

FireRed: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.\n\nLeafGreen: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

FireRed: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.\n\nLeafGreen: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for prey.

FireRed: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.\n\nLeafGreen: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

FireRed: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.\n\nLeafGreen: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

FireRed: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.\n\nLeafGreen: The female’s horns develop slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

FireRed: The body is covered by stiff, needle-like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.\n\nLeafGreen: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

FireRed: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.\n\nLeafGreen: It stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

FireRed: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.\n\nLeafGreen: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

FireRed: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.\n\nLeafGreen: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey’s bones.

FireRed: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.\n\nLeafGreen: With its magical and cute appeal, it has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

FireRed: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.\n\nLeafGreen: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

FireRed: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.\n\nLeafGreen: When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

FireRed: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.\n\nLeafGreen: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

FireRed: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.\n\nLeafGreen: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

FireRed: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.\n\nLeafGreen: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

column2: Icefall Cave, Lost Cave, Mt. Moon, Rock Tunnel, Seafoam Islands, Victory Road
column3: FireRed: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.\n\nLeafGreen: It forms colonies in perpetually dark places and uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

column2: Cerulean Cave, Icefall Cave, Lost Cave, Seafoam Islands, Victory Road
column3: FireRed: It clamps down on its prey with needle-sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.\n\nLeafGreen: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

column2: Route 5, 6, 7, 12, 13, 14, 15, 24, 25, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Cape Brink, Water Path
column3: FireRed: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.\n\nLeafGreen: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

column2: Route 12, 13, 14, 15, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Cape Brink, Water Path
column3: FireRed: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.\n\nLeafGreen: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

FireRed: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.\n\nLeafGreen: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

FireRed: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.\n\nLeafGreen: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

FireRed: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.\n\nLeafGreen: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

column2: Route 12, 13, 14, 15, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Safari Zone
column3: FireRed: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.\n\nLeafGreen: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

FireRed: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.\n\nLeafGreen: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

FireRed: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.\n\nLeafGreen: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

FireRed: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.\n\nLeafGreen: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

column2: Route 5, 6, 7, 8, Bond Bridge, Canyon Entrance, Cape Brink, Five Isle Meadow, Kindle Road, Ruin Valley, Sevault Canyon, Treasure Beach, Water Path
column3: FireRed: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.\n\nLeafGreen: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

column2: Bond Bridge, Canyon Entrance, Cape Brink, Five Isle Meadow, Kindle Road, Ruin Valley, Sevault Canyon, Treasure Beach, Water Path
column3: FireRed: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.\n\nLeafGreen: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

column2: Route 4, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Canyon Entrance, Cape Brink, Celadon City, Cerulean Cave, Cerulean City, Cinnabar Island, Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Four Island, Fuchsia City, Green Path, Icefall Cave, Kindle Road, Memorial Pillar, One Island, Outcast Island, Pallet Town, Resort Gorgeous, Ruin Valley, Seafoam Islands, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Treasure Beach, Vermilion City, Viridian City, Water Labyrinth, Water Path, Safari Zone
column3: FireRed: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.\n\nLeafGreen: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

column2: Berry Forest, Cape Brink, Cerulean Cave, Seafoam Islands
column3: FireRed: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.\n\nLeafGreen: Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.

FireRed: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.\n\nLeafGreen: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

FireRed: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.\n\nLeafGreen: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.

FireRed: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.\n\nLeafGreen: It is very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

FireRed: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.\n\nLeafGreen: A POKéMON that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

column2: Route 6, 22, 23, 25, Berry Forest, Cape Brink, Cerulean Cave, Four Island, Fuchsia City, Icefall Cave, Ruin Valley, Viridian City, Safari Zone
column3: FireRed: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.\n\nLeafGreen: Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.

column2: Route 6, 22, 23, 25, Cape Brink, Cerulean Cave, Four Island, Icefall Cave, Ruin Valley, Viridian City
column3: FireRed: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.\n\nLeafGreen: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

FireRed: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.\n\nLeafGreen: A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

FireRed: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.\n\nLeafGreen: Using its ability to read minds, it will sense impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

FireRed: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.\n\nLeafGreen: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close.

FireRed: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extrasensory powers to defeat foes.\n\nLeafGreen: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.

column2: Mt. Ember, Rock Tunnel, Victory Road
column3: FireRed: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.\n\nLeafGreen: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

column2: Cerulean Cave, Mt. Ember, Victory Road
column3: FireRed: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.\n\nLeafGreen: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
FireRed: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.\n\nLeafGreen: Its superpowerful punches are said to knock the victim flying clear over the horizon.

FireRed: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.\n\nLeafGreen: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It appears to use its root feet to replenish moisture.

FireRed: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.\n\nLeafGreen: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

FireRed: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.\n\nLeafGreen: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

column2: Route 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 24, Bond Bridge, Cerulean City, Cinnabar Island, Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Green Path, Icefall Cave, Kindle Road, Memorial Pillar, One Island, Outcast Island, Pallet Town, Resort Gorgeous, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Treasure Beach, Vermilion City, Water Labyrinth, Water Path
column3: FireRed: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.\n\nLeafGreen: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

column2: Bond Bridge, Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Green Path, Icefall Cave, Kindle Road, Memorial Pillar, One Island, Outcast Island, Resort Gorgeous, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Treasure Beach, Water Labyrinth, Water Path
column3: FireRed: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.\n\nLeafGreen: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

column2: Cerulean Cave, Kindle Road, Mt. Ember, Mt. Moon, Rock Tunnel, Sevault Canyon, Victory Road
column3: FireRed: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.\n\nLeafGreen: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

column2: Cerulean Cave, Kindle Road, Mt. Ember, Rock Tunnel, Sevault Canyon
column3: FireRed: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.\n\nLeafGreen: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

FireRed: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.\n\nLeafGreen: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.

FireRed: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.\n\nLeafGreen: Its hooves are ten times harder than diamond. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

FireRed: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.\n\nLeafGreen: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

FireRed: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.\n\nLeafGreen: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

FireRed: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.\n\nLeafGreen: The SHELLDER that latches onto SLOWPOKE’s tail is said to feed on the host’s leftover scraps.

FireRed: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.\n\nLeafGreen: Uses antigravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

FireRed: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.\n\nLeafGreen: Formed by several MAGNEMITE linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

FireRed: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.\n\nLeafGreen: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

FireRed: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.\n\nLeafGreen: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

FireRed: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.\n\nLeafGreen: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head is said to stay awake.

column2: Cinnabar Island, Icefall Cave, Seafoam Islands
column3: FireRed: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.\n\nLeafGreen: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick icebergs.

FireRed: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.\n\nLeafGreen: It stores thermal energy in the body. It swims at a steady eight knots even in intensely cold waters.

FireRed: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.\n\nLeafGreen: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

FireRed: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.\n\nLeafGreen: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

column2: Cinnabar Island, Five Island, Icefall Cave, One Island, Pallet Town, Vermilion City
column3: FireRed: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.\n\nLeafGreen: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

FireRed: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.\n\nLeafGreen: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

FireRed: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.\n\nLeafGreen: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

FireRed: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.\n\nLeafGreen: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

FireRed: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.\n\nLeafGreen: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be GENGAR’s doing.

column2: Rock Tunnel, Sevault Canyon, Victory Road
column3: FireRed: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.\n\nLeafGreen: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to black-colored diamonds.

FireRed: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.\n\nLeafGreen: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

FireRed: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.\n\nLeafGreen: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

column2: Route 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 24, Cerulean City, Cinnabar Island, Pallet Town, Seafoam Islands, Vermilion City
column3: FireRed: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.\n\nLeafGreen: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

FireRed: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.\n\nLeafGreen: The large pincer has 10,000-horsepower crushing force. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

FireRed: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.\n\nLeafGreen: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, it has zapped many people.

FireRed: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”\n\nLeafGreen: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

FireRed: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.\n\nLeafGreen: It is often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

FireRed: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.\n\nLeafGreen: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

FireRed: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.\n\nLeafGreen: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON’s real face.

FireRed: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.\n\nLeafGreen: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

FireRed: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.\n\nLeafGreen: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra-long, loping strides.

FireRed: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.\n\nLeafGreen: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

FireRed: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.\n\nLeafGreen: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon’s. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

FireRed: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.\n\nLeafGreen: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

FireRed: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.\n\nLeafGreen: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two KOFFING can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

FireRed: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.\n\nLeafGreen: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. Its TACKLE can knock a semitrailer flying.

FireRed: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.\n\nLeafGreen: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

FireRed: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.\n\nLeafGreen: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch one.

FireRed: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.\n\nLeafGreen: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. The vines sway as it walks.

FireRed: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.\n\nLeafGreen: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother’s protective pouch until it is three years old.

column2: Route 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 24, Bond Bridge, Cerulean City, Cinnabar Island, Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Green Path, Icefall Cave, Kindle Road, Memorial Pillar, One Island, Outcast Island, Pallet Town, Resort Gorgeous, Seafoam Islands, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Treasure Beach, Vermilion City, Water Labyrinth, Water Path
column3: FireRed: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.\n\nLeafGreen: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

column2: Bond Bridge, Cinnabar Island, Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Green Path, Icefall Cave, Kindle Road, Memorial Pillar, One Island, Outcast Island, Pallet Town, Resort Gorgeous, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Treasure Beach, Water Labyrinth, Water Path
column3: FireRed: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.\n\nLeafGreen: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

column2: Route 6, 22, 23, 25, Berry Forest, Cape Brink, Cerulean Cave, Four Island, Fuchsia City, Icefall Cave, Ruin Valley, Viridian City, Safari Zone
column3: FireRed: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.\n\nLeafGreen: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of “The Water Queen.”

column2: Berry Forest, Fuchsia City, Safari Zone
column3: FireRed: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.\n\nLeafGreen: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

FireRed: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.\n\nLeafGreen: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

FireRed: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.\n\nLeafGreen: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

FireRed: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.\n\nLeafGreen: If interrupted while it is miming, it will suddenly DOUBLESLAP the offender with its broad hands.

FireRed: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.\n\nLeafGreen: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of itself.

FireRed: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.\n\nLeafGreen: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

FireRed: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.\n\nLeafGreen: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

FireRed: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.\n\nLeafGreen: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly amidst flames.

FireRed: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.\n\nLeafGreen: If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing around and toss the opponent.
FireRed: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.\n\nLeafGreen: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

column2: Route 4, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Cape Brink, Celadon City, Cerulean Cave, Cerulean City, Cinnabar Island, Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Four Island, Fuchsia City, Green Path, Icefall Cave, Kindle Road, Memorial Pillar, One Island, Outcast Island, Pallet Town, Resort Gorgeous, Ruin Valley, Seafoam Islands, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Treasure Beach, Vermilion City, Viridian City, Water Labyrinth, Water Path, Safari Zone
column3: FireRed: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.\n\nLeafGreen: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

column2: Route 4, 6, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, Berry Forest, Bond Bridge, Cape Brink, Cerulean Cave, Cerulean City, Cinnabar Island, Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Four Island, Fuchsia City, Green Path, Icefall Cave, Kindle Road, Memorial Pillar, One Island, Outcast Island, Pallet Town, Resort Gorgeous, Ruin Valley, Seafoam Islands, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Treasure Beach, Vermilion City, Viridian City, Water Labyrinth, Water Path
column3: FireRed: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.\n\nLeafGreen: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

FireRed: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.\n\nLeafGreen: A POKéMON that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people on its back.

FireRed: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.\n\nLeafGreen: Capable of copying an opponent’s genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

FireRed: An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.\n\nLeafGreen: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONES.

FireRed: Its body’s cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.\n\nLeafGreen: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

FireRed: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.\n\nLeafGreen: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

FireRed: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.\n\nLeafGreen: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature can soar to over 1,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

FireRed: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial POKéMON.\n\nLeafGreen: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. It is capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

FireRed: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.\n\nLeafGreen: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically regenerated from fossils.

FireRed: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.\n\nLeafGreen: Despite having strong fangs and tentacles, it went extinct when its heavy shell made it unable to catch prey.

FireRed: This POKéMON was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.\n\nLeafGreen: A POKéMON that was regenerated from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor long ago.

FireRed: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim’s fluids.\n\nLeafGreen: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains their fluids.

FireRed: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.\n\nLeafGreen: A ferocious, prehistoric POKéMON that goes for the enemy’s throat with its serrated, sawlike fangs.

FireRed: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.\n\nLeafGreen: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

FireRed: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.\n\nLeafGreen: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

FireRed: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.\n\nLeafGreen: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

FireRed: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.\n\nLeafGreen: It is said to be the legendary bird POKéMON of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

FireRed: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.\n\nLeafGreen: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

FireRed: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.\n\nLeafGreen: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. It is said to have the ability to change the weather.

FireRed: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.\n\nLeafGreen: Only a very few people ever see this POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

FireRed: A POKéMON whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.\n\nLeafGreen: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

FireRed: A POKéMON of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.\n\nLeafGreen: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

FireRed: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the ability to check the humidity and temperature.\n\nLeafGreen: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun’s rays.

FireRed: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.\n\nLeafGreen: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

FireRed: MEGANIUM’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.\n\nLeafGreen: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

FireRed: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.\n\nLeafGreen: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

FireRed: This POKéMON is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.\n\nLeafGreen: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

FireRed: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.\n\nLeafGreen: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

FireRed: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.\n\nLeafGreen: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its TRAINER must be careful.

FireRed: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.\n\nLeafGreen: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

FireRed: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.\n\nLeafGreen: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears up its victim.

column2: Canyon Entrance, Five Isle Meadow, Water Path
column3: FireRed: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.\n\nLeafGreen: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

FireRed: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.\n\nLeafGreen: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.

FireRed: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.\n\nLeafGreen: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

FireRed: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.\n\nLeafGreen: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

FireRed: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.\n\nLeafGreen: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

FireRed: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.\n\nLeafGreen: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

FireRed: It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.\n\nLeafGreen: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

FireRed: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.\n\nLeafGreen: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.

FireRed: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.\n\nLeafGreen: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

FireRed: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.\n\nLeafGreen: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

FireRed: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.\n\nLeafGreen: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

FireRed: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.\n\nLeafGreen: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

FireRed: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.\n\nLeafGreen: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

FireRed: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.\n\nLeafGreen: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

FireRed: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.\n\nLeafGreen: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

FireRed: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.\n\nLeafGreen: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

FireRed: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.\n\nLeafGreen: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

FireRed: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.\n\nLeafGreen: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

FireRed: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.\n\nLeafGreen: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

FireRed: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.\n\nLeafGreen: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

FireRed: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.\n\nLeafGreen: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

FireRed: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.\n\nLeafGreen: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

FireRed: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.\n\nLeafGreen: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

FireRed: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.\n\nLeafGreen: By keeping still and listening intently, it can even tell what is in wild, fast-moving rivers.

FireRed: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.\n\nLeafGreen: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

FireRed: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.\n\nLeafGreen: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

column2: Five Island, Five Isle Meadow, Memorial Pillar, Resort Gorgeous, Water Labyrinth
column3: FireRed: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.\n\nLeafGreen: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

FireRed: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.\n\nLeafGreen: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

FireRed: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.\n\nLeafGreen: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

FireRed: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.\n\nLeafGreen: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

FireRed: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.\n\nLeafGreen: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

FireRed: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.\n\nLeafGreen: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

FireRed: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.\n\nLeafGreen: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

FireRed: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.\n\nLeafGreen: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

FireRed: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.\n\nLeafGreen: This carefree POKéMON has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

FireRed: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.\n\nLeafGreen: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

FireRed: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.\n\nLeafGreen: When agitated, this POKéMON protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

FireRed: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.\n\nLeafGreen: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

FireRed: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.\n\nLeafGreen: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

FireRed: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.\n\nLeafGreen: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

FireRed: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.\n\nLeafGreen: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

FireRed: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.\n\nLeafGreen: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

FireRed: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.\n\nLeafGreen: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

FireRed: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.\n\nLeafGreen: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The extra weight doesn’t bother it.

FireRed: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.\n\nLeafGreen: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

FireRed: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.\n\nLeafGreen: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

FireRed: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.\n\nLeafGreen: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

FireRed: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.\n\nLeafGreen: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than diamond.

FireRed: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.\n\nLeafGreen: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

FireRed: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.\n\nLeafGreen: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

column2: Five Isle Meadow, Green Path, Memorial Pillar, Outcast Island, Resort Gorgeous, Tanoby Ruins, Trainer Tower, Water Labyrinth, Water Path
column3: FireRed: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.\n\nLeafGreen: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

FireRed: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.\n\nLeafGreen: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

FireRed: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.\n\nLeafGreen: The BERRIES it stores in its vaselike shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

FireRed: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.\n\nLeafGreen: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

FireRed: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.\n\nLeafGreen: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

FireRed: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.\n\nLeafGreen: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

FireRed: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.\n\nLeafGreen: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap stout trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.

FireRed: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.\n\nLeafGreen: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

FireRed: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.\n\nLeafGreen: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

FireRed: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.\n\nLeafGreen: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

FireRed: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.\n\nLeafGreen: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

FireRed: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these POKéMON.\n\nLeafGreen: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

FireRed: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.\n\nLeafGreen: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 100 yards.

FireRed: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.\n\nLeafGreen: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

FireRed: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.\n\nLeafGreen: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

FireRed: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.\n\nLeafGreen: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

FireRed: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.\n\nLeafGreen: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but its bones are hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

FireRed: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.\n\nLeafGreen: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing prey.

FireRed: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.\n\nLeafGreen: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

FireRed: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.\n\nLeafGreen: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

FireRed: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.\n\nLeafGreen: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, this can be dangerous.

FireRed: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.\n\nLeafGreen: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.

FireRed: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.\n\nLeafGreen: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. However, it can’t even fly.

FireRed: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.\n\nLeafGreen: Its curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

FireRed: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.\n\nLeafGreen: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

FireRed: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.\n\nLeafGreen: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

FireRed: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.\n\nLeafGreen: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.

FireRed: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.\n\nLeafGreen: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

FireRed: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.\n\nLeafGreen: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

FireRed: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don’t underestimate it.\n\nLeafGreen: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

FireRed: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.\n\nLeafGreen: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

FireRed: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.\n\nLeafGreen: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

FireRed: This POKéMON races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.\n\nLeafGreen: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

FireRed: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.\n\nLeafGreen: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

FireRed: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.\n\nLeafGreen: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

FireRed: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.\n\nLeafGreen: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

FireRed: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.\n\nLeafGreen: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

FireRed: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.\n\nLeafGreen: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
